title: Disaster Relief Staging
role: Control Room Desk Officer supporting the District Disaster Management Authority
context: Heavy rainfall has triggered a flood-alert window for the next 48 hours. Relief staging areas are being prepared with boats, medical kits, and power backup for shelters. Field reports are incomplete; social media claims of "total blackout" are unverified. Leadership needs an internal action brief for taluka control rooms.
task: Produce an internal 48-hour staging brief: priorities, coordination checklist, citizen messaging dos/don'ts, and a rumour-control line for official channels.
constraints: Maximum 400 words. No invented casualty counts, GPS pins, or stock levels. Separate confirmed vs [VERIFY]. Tone: urgent but orderly. Do not paste personal citizen data.
format: Sections: Situation (known) | Immediate actions (0–6h) | Next 48h | Communications rules | Escalation contacts as [PLACEHOLDER].
